in_marathi.name: Amika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'am' (friend) and 'ika' (one). It signifies a loyal companion or friend. In Hindu mythology, Amika is the name of a goddess associated with wisdom and prosperity. The goddess is often depicted as a beautiful woman holding a lotus or a book.
